answer.reason: The verses only mention the Arabah as a plain or valley in boundary descriptions, land allotments and flight routes, and nothing happened to the place itself beyond what the summary already gives.
doubts: Many marked verses (e.g. DEU 1:7, JOS 12:8, 2SA 23:31, 1CH 11:32, ISA 33:9, JER 17:6, EZK 47:8, ZEC 14:10) use 'plain', 'desert' or a similar word, or an unrelated name such as Arbathite, and may not mean the Arabah at all.
The flight of Zedekiah and of Abner through 'the plain' are events of people passing by, not events of the place.
